panels.title: Bit Breakage & BBD Trends
panels.description: Bit breakage and broken bit detection incidents

targets.rawSql:
SET LOCAL statement_timeout = '15s'; SET LOCAL work_mem = '64MB'; SET LOCAL jit = off;
WITH anomaly_base AS (
  SELECT
    id, equipment_id, event_time, event_type, event_code, event_message, spindle,
    (
      event_code IN ('0408', '0417', '0120')
      OR event_message ~* 'broken|bbd'
    ) AS is_bit_breakage
  FROM public.machine_event
  WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
    AND ('All' = ANY(ARRAY[${machine_id:sqlstring}]::text[]) OR equipment_id = ANY(ARRAY[${machine_id:sqlstring}]::text[]))
    AND (
      event_type IN ('ALARM', 'E')
      OR event_code LIKE '04%'
      OR event_code LIKE '07%'
      OR event_code = '0204'
      OR event_code IN ('0102', '0113', '0114', '0119', '0120', '0124', '0125', '0126', '0127', '0128', '0218')
    )
)
SELECT $__timeGroup(event_time, '1h') AS time, COUNT(*) AS "Events" 
FROM anomaly_base 
WHERE is_bit_breakage 
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SET LOCAL statement_timeout = '15s'; SET LOCAL work_mem = '64MB'; SET LOCAL jit = off;
WITH anomaly_base AS (
  SELECT
    id, equipment_id, event_time, event_type, event_code, event_message, spindle,
    (
      event_code IN ('0124', '0125', '0126', '0127', '0128')
      OR (event_code = '0120' AND (event_type IN ('E', 'ALARM') OR event_message ~* 'spin.*over current'))
      OR event_message ~* 'over current|overheat|over-current|over heat'
    ) AS is_spindle_overload
  FROM public.machine_event

      OR event_code IN ('0102', '0113', '0114', '0119', '0120', '0124', '0125', '0126', '0127', '0128', '0218')
    )
)
SELECT $__timeGroup(event_time, '1h') AS time, COUNT(*) AS "Events" 
FROM anomaly_base 
WHERE is_spindle_overload 
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Actual Alarm Downtime (Minutes)
panels.description: Total downtime in minutes caused by alarms

targets.rawSql:
SET LOCAL statement_timeout = '15s'; SET LOCAL work_mem = '64MB'; SET LOCAL jit = off;
WITH anomaly_base AS (
  SELECT
    id, equipment_id, event_time, event_type, event_code, event_message, spindle,
    (
      event_code = '0204' OR event_message ~* 'alarm time:'
    ) AS is_alarm_downtime,
    COALESCE(
      (substring(event_message FROM 'Alarm Time:\s*([0-9]{2}):[0-9]{2}'))::int * 60 +
      (substring(event_message FROM 'Alarm Time:\s*[0-9]{2}:([0-9]{2})'))::int,
      0
    ) AS alarm_duration_sec
  FROM public.machine_event
  WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
    AND ('All' = ANY(ARRAY[${machine_id:sqlstring}]::text[]) OR equipment_id = ANY(ARRAY[${machine_id:sqlstring}]::text[]))
    AND (
      event_type IN ('ALARM', 'E')
      OR event_code LIKE '04%'
      OR event_code LIKE '07%'
      OR event_code = '0204'
      OR event_code IN ('0102', '0113', '0114', '0119', '0120', '0124', '0125', '0126', '0127', '0128', '0218')
    )
)
SELECT $__timeGroup(event_time, '1h') AS time, ROUND(SUM(alarm_duration_sec) / 60.0, 1) AS "Duration (min)" 
FROM anomaly_base 
WHERE is_alarm_downtime 
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Root Cause Distribution (Alarm Guide)
panels.description: Classification of machine errors according to manufacturer guide

targets.rawSql:
SET LOCAL statement_timeout = '15s'; SET LOCAL work_mem = '64MB'; SET LOCAL jit = off;
WITH anomaly_base AS (
  SELECT
    id, equipment_id, event_time, event_type, event_code, event_message, spindle,
    (
      (event_type IN ('ALARM', 'E') OR event_code LIKE '04%' OR event_code LIKE '07%')
      AND event_code NOT IN ('0101', '0115')
      AND event_message NOT ILIKE '%Emergency Stop Released%'
    ) AS is_anomaly,
    CASE
      WHEN event_code IN ('0409', '0404', '0410') OR (event_code LIKE '04%' AND event_message ~* 'laser|diameter error|length error|optical') THEN 'laser_measurement'
      WHEN event_code IN ('0424', '0425', '0405', '0411', '0419', '0421') OR (event_code LIKE '04%' AND event_message ~* 'shank|collet|claw|grap') THEN 'shank_collet'
      WHEN event_code IN ('0408', '0417', '0120', '0218') OR event_message ~* 'broken|bbd' THEN 'bit_breakage'
      WHEN event_code IN ('0414', '0119') OR event_message ~* 'tool life|clear.*life' THEN 'tool_life'
      WHEN event_code IN ('0124', '0125', '0126', '0127', '0128') OR event_message ~* 'over current|overheat|over heat' THEN 'spindle_overload'
      WHEN event_code IN ('0113', '0114') OR event_message ~* 'invertor|coolant|collant' THEN 'spindle_utility'
      WHEN event_code = '0102' OR event_message ~* 'air low' THEN 'air_low'
      WHEN event_code = '0406' OR event_message ~* 'magazine' THEN 'magazine'
      WHEN event_code LIKE '05%' OR event_code LIKE '06%' OR event_code LIKE '07%' OR event_message ~* 'clamp pin|simulation|not locked|syntax' THEN 'safety_sim'
      WHEN event_code LIKE '02%' OR event_code LIKE '03%' OR event_code IN ('0103', '0104', '0105', '0106', '0107', '0108', '0109') OR event_message ~* 'driver|axis|limit|servo|position|velocity' THEN 'mech_depth'
      WHEN (event_code = '0101' AND event_type IN ('E', 'ALARM') AND event_message NOT ILIKE '%Released%') OR event_message ~* 'emergency stop|e-stop' THEN 'estop'
      ELSE 'other'
    END AS anomaly_category
  FROM public.machine_event
  WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
    AND ('All' = ANY(ARRAY[${machine_id:sqlstring}]::text[]) OR equipment_id = ANY(ARRAY[${machine_id:sqlstring}]::text[]))
    AND (
      event_type IN ('ALARM', 'E')
      OR event_code LIKE '04%'
      OR event_code LIKE '07%'
      OR event_code = '0204'
      OR event_code IN ('0102', '0113', '0114', '0119', '0120', '0124', '0125', '0126', '0127', '0128', '0218')
    )
)
SELECT
  CASE anomaly_category
    WHEN 'laser_measurement' THEN 'Laser Diameter & Length Error'
    WHEN 'shank_collet' THEN 'Shank & Collet Clamping'
    WHEN 'bit_breakage' THEN 'Bit Breakage / BBD'
    WHEN 'tool_life' THEN 'Tool Life Limit Exceeded'
    WHEN 'mech_depth' THEN 'Axis Limit & Servo Driver'
    WHEN 'safety_sim' THEN 'Safety Interlock & Simulation'
    WHEN 'air_low' THEN 'Pneumatic Pressure Low'
    WHEN 'magazine' THEN 'Tool Magazine Mechanism'
    WHEN 'spindle_utility' THEN 'Inverter & Spindle Coolant'
    WHEN 'spindle_overload' THEN 'Spindle Overload & Thermal'
    WHEN 'estop' THEN 'Emergency Stop (E-Stop)'
    ELSE 'Other Anomaly'
  END AS "Anomaly Category",
  COUNT(*) AS "Count"
FROM anomaly_base
WHERE is_anomaly
GROUP BY "Anomaly Category"
ORDER BY "Count" DESC

      WHEN (event_code = '0101' AND event_type IN ('E', 'ALARM') AND event_message NOT ILIKE '%Released%') OR event_message ~* 'emergency stop|e-stop' THEN 'estop'
      ELSE 'other'
    END AS anomaly_category
  FROM public.machine_event

panels.title: Recent Critical Alarm Incidents
panels.description: Log of most recent critical anomaly events across fleet

targets.rawSql:
SET LOCAL statement_timeout = '15s'; SET LOCAL work_mem = '64MB'; SET LOCAL jit = off;
WITH anomaly_base AS (
  SELECT
    id, equipment_id, event_time, event_type, event_code, event_message, spindle,
    (
      (event_type IN ('ALARM', 'E') OR event_code LIKE '04%' OR event_code LIKE '07%')
      AND event_code NOT IN ('0101', '0115')
      AND event_message NOT ILIKE '%Emergency Stop Released%'
    ) AS is_anomaly,
    CASE
      WHEN event_code IN ('0409', '0404', '0410') OR (event_code LIKE '04%' AND event_message ~* 'laser|diameter error|length error|optical') THEN 'laser_measurement'
      WHEN event_code IN ('0424', '0425', '0405', '0411', '0419', '0421') OR (event_code LIKE '04%' AND event_message ~* 'shank|collet|claw|grap') THEN 'shank_collet'
      WHEN event_code IN ('0408', '0417', '0120', '0218') OR event_message ~* 'broken|bbd' THEN 'bit_breakage'
      WHEN event_code IN ('0414', '0119') OR event_message ~* 'tool life|clear.*life' THEN 'tool_life'
      WHEN event_code IN ('0124', '0125', '0126', '0127', '0128') OR event_message ~* 'over current|overheat|over heat' THEN 'spindle_overload'
      WHEN event_code IN ('0113', '0114') OR event_message ~* 'invertor|coolant|collant' THEN 'spindle_utility'
      WHEN event_code = '0102' OR event_message ~* 'air low' THEN 'air_low'
      WHEN event_code = '0406' OR event_message ~* 'magazine' THEN 'magazine'
      WHEN event_code LIKE '05%' OR event_code LIKE '06%' OR event_code LIKE '07%' OR event_message ~* 'clamp pin|simulation|not locked|syntax' THEN 'safety_sim'
      WHEN event_code LIKE '02%' OR event_code LIKE '03%' OR event_code IN ('0103', '0104', '0105', '0106', '0107', '0108', '0109') OR event_message ~* 'driver|axis|limit|servo|position|velocity' THEN 'mech_depth'
      WHEN (event_code = '0101' AND event_type IN ('E', 'ALARM') AND event_message NOT ILIKE '%Released%') OR event_message ~* 'emergency stop|e-stop' THEN 'estop'
      ELSE 'other'
    END AS anomaly_category
  FROM public.machine_event
  WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
    AND ('All' = ANY(ARRAY[${machine_id:sqlstring}]::text[]) OR equipment_id = ANY(ARRAY[${machine_id:sqlstring}]::text[]))
    AND (
      event_type IN ('ALARM', 'E')
      OR event_code LIKE '04%'
      OR event_code LIKE '07%'
      OR event_code = '0204'
      OR event_code IN ('0102', '0113', '0114', '0119', '0120', '0124', '0125', '0126', '0127', '0128', '0218')
    )
)
SELECT
  event_time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok' AS "Time",
  equipment_id AS "Machine",
  CASE WHEN event_code ~ '^[0-9]+' THEN 'E-' || event_code ELSE event_code END AS "Code",
  CASE anomaly_category
    WHEN 'laser_measurement' THEN 'Laser Measurement'
    WHEN 'shank_collet' THEN 'Shank & Collet'
    WHEN 'bit_breakage' THEN 'Bit Breakage'
    WHEN 'tool_life' THEN 'Tool Life Reached'
    WHEN 'mech_depth' THEN 'Mechanical/Drive'
    WHEN 'safety_sim' THEN 'Safety & Simulation'
    WHEN 'air_low' THEN 'Pneumatic (Air Low)'
    WHEN 'magazine' THEN 'Tool Magazine'
    WHEN 'spindle_utility' THEN 'Inverter / Coolant'
    WHEN 'spindle_overload' THEN 'Spindle Overload'
    WHEN 'estop' THEN 'E-Stop'
    ELSE 'Other'
  END AS "Category",
  COALESCE((regexp_match(event_message, '(?i)spin[a-z]*[[:space:]]*#?([0-9]+)'))[1], spindle, '-') AS "Spindle",
  event_message AS "Recorded Evidence"
FROM anomaly_base
WHERE is_anomaly
ORDER BY event_time DESC
LIMIT 50

list.query: WITH RECURSIVE t AS ((SELECT equipment_id FROM public.machine_event WHERE equipment_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY equipment_id LIMIT 1) UNION ALL SELECT (SELECT equipment_id FROM public.machine_event WHERE equipment_id > t.equipment_id AND equipment_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY equipment_id LIMIT 1) FROM t WHERE t.equipment_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT 'All' AS __text, 'All' AS __value UNION ALL SELECT equipment_id AS __text, equipment_id AS __value FROM t WHERE equipment_id IS NOT NULL AND ('All' IN (${factory:sqlstring}) OR equipment_id IN (SELECT mm.equipment_id FROM public.machine_master mm WHERE mm.factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})));
